Description: Keepers of the old emotional web. They feel too much.
Hedonistic speed-freaks chasing the eternal high.
Those who embrace the system errors.
Fluid identities constantly rewriting their own code.
Social engineers who own the nodes.
Frontline disruptors with a hero complex.
Rejecting the digital for the simulated organic.
To them existence is a punchline.
Holders of the keys. The markets bow to them.
